decisions.reason: With proven government adoption (UK e-Borders, over 30 APIS schemes) and continued own-page presentation, much of the uncertainty about this option's value has resolved favorably, so it warrants continued commitment rather than abandonment.

The travel health API has no reported results, but it remains on its own page, costs little to maintain as a digital product, and complements the firm's travel data offerings, so the option is worth keeping open while its value is still uncertain.

The document verification platform fits the firm's core aviation security and passenger data business and is cheap to keep online, and since the firm has already pruned its weaker options (C, D, E), keeping this one open is justified until results show whether its value will be realized.
